name: Product Launch
description: Plan and execute a product launch from market evidence through positioning, readiness, rollout, and learning.

tasks.name: Lock launch contract
tasks.objective: Define target outcome, launch type, target segment/ICP, product readiness assumptions, geography, pricing/packaging constraints, success metrics, decision owners, launch window, and explicit non-goals.

tasks.name: Build market and customer evidence
tasks.objective: Synthesize customer interviews, usage/support data, win-loss, category dynamics, alternatives, purchase triggers, objections, and competitor positioning. Separate observed customer language from internal adjectives.

tasks.name: Create positioning and message architecture
tasks.objective: Define target segment, problem, differentiated value, category/frame, proof, objections, messaging hierarchy, and claims that can be substantiated.

tasks.name: Design go-to-market system
tasks.objective: Choose channels, distribution, launch sequence, pricing/packaging expression, sales/customer-success enablement, lifecycle messaging, partnerships, content, and operational handoffs.

tasks.name: Run launch readiness review
tasks.objective: Audit product stability, analytics, support, docs, legal/compliance, billing, enablement, localization, rollback/incident plans, and dependencies. Record blockers and owners.

tasks.name: Execute controlled launch
tasks.objective: Ship according to the approved sequence; monitor activation, conversion, errors, support signals, qualitative feedback, and channel response. Keep a timestamped decision log.

tasks.name: Post-launch learning loop
tasks.objective: Compare outcomes to hypotheses, segment results, identify leading/lagging signals, separate channel execution from product/market mismatch, and produce keep/change/stop decisions.
